_README: ATUL / SADBHAV / RENUKA consolidated PAT put onto the OWNERS convention, 2026-08-09.
owners = profit for the period - non-controlling interest, from each quarter's OWN filing.
Each window is closed by a printed full-year or half-year OWNERS subtotal; see the applier
docstring and runbook §69. Cells NOT changed but suspect: ATUL 20210630 (stored 165.15, the
FY22 owners subtotal 604.26 implies 165.94) and SADBHAV 20200331 (stored 886.63 against a
standalone of 8.18, wildly out of family -- no P&L page located in that filing).

2026-08-09 second pass: ATUL FY21+FY22 closed out (Jun-20, Mar-21, Jun-21, Sep-21, Dec-21). SADBHAV 2020-03-31 was RE-CHECKED and is CORRECT as stored: the Jun-2020 filing prints Mar-20 period 1280.78 and NCI 394.14 -> owners 886.64, and FY20 owners -8.07 + -15.94 + -69.79 + 886.63 = 792.83 exactly as printed. The value only looked wrong because it is a very large genuine one-off -- the RENUKA lesson (runbook §69c).

2026-08-09 third pass: the named fund-vs-revop cells (ATUL Sep-25, SADBHAV Dec-20, RENUKA Dec-20 +Mar-21). Measuring them found sf_fundamentals and sf_revop disagree on 1,372 of 43,731 populated con-PAT cells (3.14%); the 603 where revop is exactly 0.0 against a real fundamentals value were resynced, the 716 genuine disagreements and 15 fundamentals==0 cells are NOT touched. build_discovery's TTM P/E was reading the divergent mirror. §70.

2026-08-26 (runbook §116): 53 cells across COX&KINGS / S&SPOWER / SURANAT&P whose con slot held the TOTAL. Read from each quarter's OWN consolidated XBRL: owners + NCI == total closes on 59 of 61 filings (the 2 misses are the filer's own arithmetic, Rs51k and Rs91k). 16 were exposed by the HTML-escaped phantom keys retracted in §114 -- the phantom's reader had taken the owners tag and OURS had taken the total, so the phantom was RIGHT on those and the live store was wrong. The other 37 are the rest of the same series: healing only the disagreeing cells would leave a MIXED-basis series, which breaks YoY/TTM worse than a uniformly wrong one. NOT healed: 24 cells (IL&FSENGG x23, S&SPOWER Mar-2019) where the filer tags owners=0 AND NCI=0 with the real number only in the total -- there the stored total IS correct and the phantom's 0.0 was the defect. None of these symbols is in _reattr_owners.json, which is why apply_owners_full never re-attributed them; 1,417 symbols / 18,175 con cells share that exposure and are NOT swept here.

2026-08-26 §116c SCREEN: ran the owners-vs-total check over ALL 60,768 con cells in sf_fundamentals against their own cached consolidated XBRL (38,668 filings indexed). 52 further cells healed total->owners, on top of the 53 from §116. THE GATE IS THE IDENTITY, not the comparison: 872 cells store the total while the owners tag differs, but only these reconcile as owners+NCI==total. The other 762 are REFUSED and NOT healed -- 302 have NCI=0 (so owners MUST equal total; the owners TAG is wrong and the store is right), 24 are sign flips, 13 are filer power-of-ten scale errors, and 460 have a real NCI that still does not reconcile and need per-cell documents. Also measured: coverage in _reattr_owners.json is per-CELL not per-SYMBOL -- 864 of 869 defect cells sit in symbols the cache covers but quarters it does not.

2026-08-27 §116e: 48 more cells healed total->owners, resolving part of the 460-cell §116d residue that the XBRL identity could NOT close. Each was read from the company's OWN BSE-filed consolidated result PDF (owners_total_verify.py): the filing's profit-attribution block gives owners + NCI == ProfitLossForPeriod EXACTLY (<=0.02cr), the column pinned by total==stored. Gate beyond §116d: an EXPLICIT profit-total row is required (a reconstructed owners+nci total can be the Total-Comprehensive-Income attribution, off by OCI -- that dropped MANINFRA/JAYAGROGN 0.05-0.08cr). 34 symbols incl. ADANIENT 20210331 332.53->233.95 (NCI 98.58), CHOLAHLDNG 20200331 79.57->39.91 (the exact cell §116d named unresolvable via XBRL), INDHOTEL/LUPIN/TECHM/RAIN/JINDALSAW. Deferred: the ~324 cells whose BSE P&L is a SCANNED image (free OCR mis-reads the owners line) and the older 'profit for period / less NCI / profit after NCI' format (GOLDIAM class) -- need vision or extractor work.

2026-08-27 §116e-vision: 8 more cells from SCANNED-image filings the text pass could not read, read by vision from the rendered consolidated P&L page and gated identically (owners+NCI==total exactly, total==stored). JINDALSTEL 20201231 2566.68->2254.66 (owners=continuing+discontinuing attribution, 312cr), LLOYDSENT 20251231 37.93->-7.86 (owners LOSS, minority took the profit), WAAREEENER 20251231 1106.79->1062.46, ADANIPORTS 20250630 3310.60->3314.59, KANORICHEM x4 (row cleared). NOTE: several high-proxy scanned cells were REFUSED as a DIFFERENT defect class -- their stored value does not match the filing total at all (ADANIENT 20250331 stored 1382.17 vs filed total 4014.90/owners 3844.91; AARTIIND 20210331 stored 692.34 vs 139.34; RAYMOND 20211231 stored 266.67 vs 101.07) -- flagged for separate investigation, NOT owners-vs-total.

2026-08-27 §116e Nifty-500 pass: worked the 88 unhealed 460-residue cells in current Nifty-500 members. 45 healed (1 text + 44 vision from scanned filings via render_pl.py): BIOCON x3 (Syngene NCI, ~30cr), NAVA 338.99->298.61 (Zambia power), IFCI 20241231 -8.74->-30.66, NMDC x5, BLUESTARCO x7 (row cleared), KANORICHEM x4 (row cleared), NCC, GPIL, WOCKPHARMA x2, ZENTEC x3, PIDILITIND x2, POLYCAB x2, TIINDIA, ULTRACEMCO... Not healed: NMDC 20240930/INFY/AJANTPHARM/NUVOCO/AFCONS already store owners (no-op); KAYNES x4 have NO NCI (in the residue only via XBRL power-of-ten garbage); ASIANPAINT/KAYNES 20230331 are STORED-VALUE anomalies (stored != filing total, logged in owners_total_stored_anomalies.json); GLENMARK x3/PHOENIXLTD/ONESOURCE/IFCI 20220331/CHOICEIN/PVRINOX/BEML/VBL/HINDCOPPER deferred (complex continuing+discontinuing, restatements, TCI-only, or extract-only pages). ~11 more file image P&Ls the OCR page-finder cannot key (mostly nil/tiny NCI).

2026-09-03 (G1): GFLLIMITED 20170331/20170930/20171231 con PAT held the TOTAL 'Profit for the period' where every neighbouring quarter stores owners; healed to owners from each quarter's OWN BSE consolidated attribution block (Owners (12,220)/7,149/7,019 L). Identity owners+NCI==total and GATE S' (std 52.43/88.74/94.66) both close. 2012Q1-2013Q1 filed no quarterly con statement -> LEFT.

2026-09-27 (runbook §184): IRCON and UBL 20220331 con owners pinned at the exact x100 figure of their 1/100 XBRL (scale_fix.json k=-2) -- without a pin apply_owners_full writes _reattr_owners' 2-dp scaled value / 0.01.

2026-09-28 (runbook §214a F2): consolidated owners PAT pinned for the cells the second-reader audit proved wrong, each read from the company's own filing and confirmed by an independent second reader (the reads are in each cell's note).

2026-09-28 (runbook §214a, owners-rule reach after F2): 52 more consolidated cells that stored the TOTAL (incl. minority) or a broken XBRL profit tag, pinned to the owners' profit as printed in each quarter's own result PDF and confirmed by a later filing or Moneycontrol (both reads in each cell's note). 19 flagged cells were already right (filer XBRL mis-tags) and 5 filings print no owners split — none of those written.
